children: Stock-specific activity is likely to remain in focus on Dalal Street on September 2, following a slew of corporate developments, order win.

EMS share price surged 9% after company received the lowest bidder (L-1) status awarded by Directorate of Local Bodies, Government of Rajasthan for Sewerage Work. The Estimated order value (including GST) is approximately Rs 21,864.75 lakhs.

Share price of Hero MotoCorp slipped 2% despite company reported 2.65% growth in total sales at 5.68 lakh units in August, compared with 5.54 lakh units in the year-ago period. Motorcycle sales, however, declined 1.53% to 4.94 lakh units from 5.02 lakh units a year earlier. Export sales dropped 24.6% to 26,093 units from 34,588 units in August last year.

Welspun Corp share price touched 52-week high after company and Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the developers of Jordan’s National Water Carrier Project and the Government of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan for the development of pipe manufacturing and advanced coating facilities in Jordan. As per the MoU, Perma-Pipe and Welspun Corp have partnered to establish an integrated pipe manufacturing and coating platform in Jordan, capable of serving major water, oil and gas, energy, and infrastructure projects in the Kingdom and across surrounding regional markets.

Shares of Sical Logistics advanced 5% following the company received a Letter of Acceptance from Central Coalfields for the execution of work involving the hiring of heavy earth-moving machinery (HEMM) for overburden (OB) removal and coal extraction from the diverted 143-hectare patch of lower seams of the SDOC Mine in the Dhori area of Jharkhand. The contract is for a period of five years and has a total value of Rs 534.73 crore.

Investors are expected to remain focused on brokerage calls, block deals, order wins, regulatory developments and other company-specific triggers that could drive stock-level volatility during the session.

title: Buzzing Stocks: EMS shares surge 9% on order win; Hero MotoCorp slips 2% as exports decline
